reading.body:
EdgeCore Ashburn AS02 is a 114 MW data center campus in Sterling, Virginia, representing 7.1 percent of the state's published data center IT capacity and ranking third among the 25 Virginia facilities that disclose megawatts.

Virginia's 330 mapped data centers publish a combined 1,603 MW of IT capacity, but most facilities do not disclose figures, so the true state total is substantially larger. At 114 MW and 685,000 square feet, this campus is material infrastructure for AI model training or serving at scale, and its Ashburn location places it within Northern Virginia's existing power and network backbone.

The data does not include grid constraints, actual utilization, or expansion plans, so it cannot show whether this facility can draw its full 114 MW or how much headroom remains in the region. LEED certification indicates environmentally managed operations, but no energy source or efficiency figures are published here.
